notes.content: [p]- New Class, Fighter! His special attack reduces enemy armor by a percentage and can stack.[/p][p]- Show level on item icons.[/p][p]- Game should default to main monitor on multiple monitor setups.[/p][p]- Healing spell now costs `10 + (10% of max deity power)` to cast. notes.title: Update 19 - New Class: Cleric! Blacksmith Reforging!
notes.content:
[b]Update v19 Patch Notes[/b]
Simplifying version naming. Instead of 0.0.X style updates, future versions will just be numbered like "version 19" to keep things cleaner.

[b]New Features[/b]
- Blacksmith – Reforging System: Allows rerolling a specific stat on an item; chosen stat is reset to 0, and its points are randomly redistributed. Cost WIP, may require materials in the future.
- New Class: Cleric: Heals the lowest health party member and uses holy fire attacks. Unlockable via game progression like Ranger and Wizard.
- "Lucky Item" Spawns: Includes extra potions, gold piles, and fairies. Poison vials may now spawn and hurt the party.
- Sell All Button in Shops
- Demo Access Update: Demo users can now play level 2.

[b]Gameplay Changes[/b]
- Cleric: Healing targets the lowest party member by percentage.
- Wizard: Heal targets the lowest player by percentage. Projectile speed increased.
- Barbarian: Increased base power and health.
- Lightning Bolt: May trigger thunderstorms (fires 2 + deity level bolts at 2-second intervals).
- Fairy Healing: Now heals 50% of each party member’s health.
- Poison Vials: Damage your party if picked up; can be removed with lightning bolt.
- Armor Buff: Duration increased to 30 seconds.
- Serendipity Buff: Tooltip now shows duration. Cost increased to 7.
- Only crit damage numbers cause bonk animation.

[b]AI / Behavior Updates[/b]
- Players no longer wait for dying enemies.
- Projectiles now pass through dying enemies.

[b]UI / Visual Updates[/b]
- Transparency Method: Updated for fewer issues with semi-transparent sprites.
- UI Scaling: Some options currently disabled due to display changes.
- Save Selection UI: Now appears after using the return home deity power. Pressing Start hides the panel if no switch is desired.
- Toolbar Button: Now appears only on the right-most character and is smaller. Considering adding a move-able button for this.
- Stage Selection Billboard: No longer interferes with the title screen.
- Serendipity Buff Tooltip: Now shows duration.

[b]Bug Fixes / Technical Improvements[/b]
- Save System: Now uses SteamID for the save folder, supporting multi-account setups. Auto-migration of saves to the new location.
- Shop Inventory: Properly refreshes on each spawn.
- Coins: No longer block projectiles.
- Bird Loot: Now drops 0–3 potions and 0–(5x deity level) gold on hit.
- Potion Lifespan: Potions stay for 5 minutes before vanishing.
- Lots of small miscellaneous bug fixes.

notes.title: Update 0.1.17 - b382

- Don't allow potion use before game start.

notes.title: Update 0.1.16 - b379
notes.content:
[b]Update 0.1.16 - b379[/b]

- Character info tooltip no longer interferes with stat buttons
- Adjust imp collider.

notes.title: Update 0.1.15 - b376
notes.content:
[b]Update 0.1.15 - b376[/b]
Quick bug-fix.

- Fix stage select/start button not showing for characters who have yet to beat gamestage 1.

notes.title: Update 0.1.14
notes.content:
Update 0.1.14 - b374 - Demo b375
Small bug-fixes.

- Fix item disabling system. No more daggers attempt #2.
- Auras will no longer find dead players as valid targets.
- Increase item/potion drops.
- Stage select Z rotation and X position locked so it doesn't get knocked away.
- Fix auras giving the default xp value (0) instead of calculated xp value.
- Hover over the character's sprite on the character panel for class-specific information.

notes.title: Update 0.1.13
notes.content:
[b]Update 0.1.13[/b]

- Character unlocks moved from levels 3 and 6 to levels 2 and 5.
- New stage select panel.
- Projectiles will no longer collide with other projectiles.
- Adjust hit-boxes on lots of enemies.
- Bosses should show proper falling-letter names.
- Pull wizard projectile speed back a bit.
- Fix bug where it wouldn't proceed to game-stage 10 after beating 9.
- The player XP bar fill can no longer be dragged.
- Lightning tool-tip now explains the repeat casting feature.
- "Buff" abilities, such as heal or luck, now give deity xp based on their spell cost.
- Lightning bolt now gives XP based on spell cost.
- Projectiles should no longer trigger twice on impact.
- Killing an enemy in range of the shop should no longer cause the game to resume progress.
- Remove dagger from item generation until a supporting class is added.
- Item drop table adjustments across all non-boss enemies.There were too many potions.
- Should now set the proper saveID internally if a saved game was renamed (ie party0.save to party1.save). Copying and renaming a saved game could possibly overwrite the game in the slot where the save originally was copied from.

notes.title: Update 0.1.12a
notes.content:
Quick bug fixes.

- Fix ranged class special attacks.,
- Fix wizard projectile velocity.

notes.title: Update Version 0.1.12
notes.content:
[b]Update Version 0.1.12[/b]

- Characters earn one stat point they can allocate into their stats each level-up. Characters already created before this update should retroactively have their extra points calculated and ready to spend. Spent points are [b]permanent [/b]at the moment and cannot be reset. Something to reset spent stat points will come at a later date.
- Increased size of party inventory from 30 to 40.
- Return home automatically loads the save you were playing.
- New button on the Options panel to return to Main Menu/Party Select.
- More UI cleanup.
- Smaller toolbar.
- Fix another case where shop value was incorrect.
- Shops no longer trigger multiple times when more than one character is in the party.

#bugs  - #feedback

notes.title: Update Version 0.1.11
notes.content:
[b]Update Version 0.1.11[/b]

- Fixed an issue where potions sometimes wouldn't collider with the player to be picked up or kicked forward.
- Ranger arrows and mage fireballs have more mass and shoot with more force.
- Fix pink edges on text from transparency bleed-through. Hurray!
- Started on a UI cleanup/slight overhaul. The UI slider can cause some hard-to-read text while the UI is being reworked. I'd recommend avoiding the UI scale slider for now, or at least setting it to default.
- Fix a problem with item sale price calculation at the shop.
- Lightning bolt will be automatically re-selected to be cast if there's enough power to do so. Cancel by right-clicking anywhere.
- Start on a window position handler to help multiple monitor situations.

Update Version 0.1.10
Small patch to address a bug.

- Don't allow lightning bolt to be selected if player does not have the required deity power.

notes.title: Update Version 0.1.9
notes.content:
[b]Update Version 0.1.9[/b]

- UI Scale Slider
- New Level 10 Boss and Miniboss. 
- New option to turn off 'Always-On-Top' mode.
- Items will show the proper icons between updates.
- New deity XP bar on the toolbar underneath your current deity power.
- Fix Imp spawn position.
- Damage numbers will no longer hurt bosses.
- Enemies will no longer attack players while at a Point of Interest, like the shop.
- Current gamestage is now shown on the player information panel.

notes.title: Update Version 0.1.8

[b]Update Version 0.1.7[/b]
